author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Porsche 911 Turbo S Leichtbau Trailer for Forza Horizon 6, the latest addition of the hit arcade action racing game developed by Playground Games. The 1993 Porsche 911 Turbo S Leichtbau is the 80pt series reward car for Horizon Decades. Overcome challenges to earn rewards starting June 18 in Forza Horizon 6, available now for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Forza Horizon 6 - Official Porsche 911 Turbo S Leichtbau Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Never Look Back, a psychological, rule-based horror game set on an infinite liminal staircase. Players have to descend the staircase, squeeze a cute rubber
duck, and never look back as the Darkness follows behind. Never Look Back is coming to pC (Steam) in November 2026.
title: Never Look Back - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard), a cozy junkyard simulator about digging through trash, finding car parts and collectibles, rescuing dogs, and slowly rebuilding your dad’s dream car. Earn money, buy missing parts, and rebuild a rusty old car piece by piece until your dream is ready to ride again. Strange customers will arrive with strange requests. Find rare parts, prepare their cars, and get paid for your work. Find lost dogs hiding in the junkyard, rescue them, give them a home, and let them help you while you work. Search for lost collectible cards and other rare treasures hidden deep in the trash. Relax and take breaks, enjoy the music, chill with your dogs, and embrace the cozy junkyard atmosphere. I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard) will be launching soon on PC (Steam).
title: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard) - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Future Sauce Dispenser, a dystopian satire set in 2145, where humanity has become so dependent on automated systems that people can no longer function without the correct sauce. You serve sauce for everything: food, phones, bricks, and increasingly absurd requests. You run the ultimate solution: The Sauce Stand. No food. No questions. Just the Sauce. Future Sauce Dispenser is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Future Sauce Dispenser - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Accolades Trailer for Thick as Thieves, a stealth action heist game developed by OtherSide Entertainment. Players will master the fine arts of deception, stealth, and thievery. Join up with friends in co-op to claim precious treasures in a 1910 Scottish city. Thick as Thieves is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Thick as Thieves - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the release date trailer for Lootbound, the tactical roguelite set in a dark fantasy world, where every run is built around loot, battles, party building, and decisions that can change the course of the game. Players start solo, meet companions along the way, choose routes and rewards, equip heroes and companions, and create builds through item synergies, damage types, and risk-reward choices.
Lootbound will be available on Xbox and PC (Steam) on July 31, 2026.
title: Lootbound - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out this latest Breakdown video for Universa, the latest fighter coming to Invincible VS. Boasting impressive range with her staff, and the ability to drain the opponent's boost meter, Universa looks set to shake-up the meta of the game. Boost meter heavy characters will certainly be sweating when Universa makes her debut in Invincible Vs Season 1 alongside The Immortal, on June 30th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Invincible VS - Official Universa Character Breakdown Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the narrative trailer for The Division 2 Into the Dark update. The Hyena faction have tightened their grip on the streets of D.C., using their all new variant of Spice to their advantage. To push them back you must return to the most dangerous place in Washington D.C, The Dark Zone. 

Tom Clancy's The Division 2 Into The Dark Update is out now!
title: The Division 2 - Official Into The Dark Narrative Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for Brick Busters, a retro-inspired roguelike top-down tank shooter with a modern twist developed by NPC At Work. Battle the odds with waves of relentless enemy tanks, crush the competition to earn upgrades and buffs to take on more and more odds. 
Brick Busters is coming soon to PC (Steam)
title: Brick Busters - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this gameplay trailer for Stories of Somnia, an all new turn-based RPG in the style of Paper Mario from Monster Theater! Explore a lush vibrant world, learn new spells and abilities, and collect Dreamkin, your very own loyal companions! 
Stories of Somnia is coming soon to PC (Steam)
title: Stories of Somnia - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this new developer update for God Save Birmingham! All new changes to combat and animations, paired with improvements to physics and of course, brand new weapons and weapon types! 

God Save Birmingham will be available on PC.
title: God Save Birmingham - Official Dev Update 3 Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Fist of the North Star arrives to clean up South Town as Kenshiro arrives in Fatal Fury: City of The Wolves! Showcasing his mastery of Hokuto No Ken arts, Kenshiro hits hard and fast with moves that're imperceptible to the human eye! 

Kenshiro arrives in Fatal Fury: City of The Wolves this June for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Fatal Fury: City of The Wolves - Official Kenshiro Character Trailer
